title: Praxis with a 3848-form mixed-radix field and tuned sampler range
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 7312 MiB (7.1404 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 498198 million field multiplications (22880 and 475318), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, H3, dec_sum_g1, P1, n, C5) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
